newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance starts new chemical plant.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance starts new chemical plant.

text.p: Indian petrochemicals firm Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) said on Monday it had commissioned a second 120,000 tonnes per annum monoethylene glycol (MEG) plant.
Its first MEG plant, also at Hazira on the western coast, has a capacity of 100,000 tonnes per annum.
"RIL is also building a third 120,000 tonnes per annum MEG plant at Hazira, identical to its second plant, expected to be completed by the end of 1997/98 (April-March)," it said.
This will make Reliance the world's 10th largest MEG producer, the company said in a statement.
MEG is one of the raw materials for producing polyester.
